In een aanmeldveld stelt de extensie een: In a sign-in field the extension suggests a strong password and fills in a one-time code in the step after signing in. After a form is sent, it asks whether to save or update the login. A passkey request from a site is caught and answered with a passkey from the vault. A login form inside an embedded frame of the same site is filled too; a frame from another site gets nothing, and every frame checks its own origin before it fills. You can also fill in through the context menu and a shortcut. An https login on an http page asks for confirmation first.
